title: Sharp Coefficient Estimates for the Exponential Starlike class $\mathcal{S}_{ex}^{\ast}$
summary: Let $\mathcal{S}_{ex}^{\ast}$ denote the class of normalized analytic functions $f$ in the unit disk satisfying \[ \frac{zf'(z)}{f(z)} \prec e^{αz},\qquad 0<α\le 1. \] We obtain sharp bounds for the initial inverse logarithmic coefficients $Γ_1$, $Γ_2$, and $Γ_3$. In particular, the bound for $|Γ_3|$ has a four-branch structure with transition values \[ α_\star \approx 0.542712,\qquad α_b \approx 0.679103,\qquad α_c \approx 0.691095. \] We also establish sharp upper and lower bounds for the successive coefficient difference \[ |Γ_2|-|Γ_1|, \] for the inverse logarithmic Hankel determinant \[…
